60' Product Opportunities

More Room to Grow—Without Moving into the Largest Product Series

Riceland's 60' homes can be a strong middle-ground for buyers who want a wider homesite, additional living space, or more flexibility than a 50' product while still remaining closer to their preferred budget.

Why Consider a 60' Home?

The 60' product provides an easy step up for buyers who need more entertaining space, larger secondary rooms, expanded garage choices, or more separation between everyday living areas.

  • Wider homesites and a more substantial exterior presence
  • Additional room for growing households and multigenerational living
  • More flexibility for studies, game rooms, media rooms, and guest spaces
  • A practical bridge between the 50' and 70' product offerings
